title: Nashville Music, History and Hidden Gems Tour
includes: Private transportation for up to 6. If more then van rental is extra.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is an intimate tour of the intricate sites and neighborhoods of Nashville from the up-close perspective of a 30 plus year local resident & business owner, professional musician, historian, and former professional published and recorded songwriter. This is not a packed bus tour with a loudspeaker. You'll be able to ask questions and have a conversation with the guide, and see some of the hidden gems of Nashville you don't commonly see on corporate tours. You'll hear unique perspectives and stories you won't hear elsewhere. It's truly an unforgettable experience.
